name: Embedded processors and smart home
artwork: Original TinyCAD vector PCB views and function pictograms; no copied photographs, logos, PCB traces or manufacturer artwork.
scope: Top/component-side wiring views. All contacts of the named wiring headers are explicit. USB, HDMI, Ethernet, ribbon sockets, test pads, solder jumpers and optional debug/auxiliary connectors are outside the wiring interface. Drawings are enlarged and snapped to the normal grid for legible wiring, not dimensioned PCB footprints. No firmware or SPICE simulation.
powerConvention: Controller 3V3/5V header rails are typed as power outputs for normal USB/barrel-powered use; VIN is a power input. Alternative power injection through header rails must follow the manufacturer instructions.

survey.basis: Coverage of common wired projects, not a sales ranking. Named board versions avoid incompatible clone and revision pinouts.

projects.name: ESPHome DIY projects: room multisensors, plant monitoring, garage distance, sprinkler controls and air quality
Seeed Grove ecosystem and Arduino/Raspberry Pi projects
Display modules with documented Raspberry Pi, ESP32/Pico or Arduino host wiring

sourceReview.decision: The user requests physical PCB arrangements and custom function icons. Original native artwork is used; the fetched ESP32 library symbol is a conventional schematic, not the required verified board/revision view. Display extensions use original front/rear PCB views with exact named host-connector pin tables; the fetched LCM1602C symbol is a parallel LCD, not the selected integrated I2C module.

entries.name: ESP32 DevKitC V4 — WROOM-32E, 38 pins
entries.notes: 3.3 V logic. GPIO34/35/36/39 are input-only. SD0/SD1/SD2/SD3/CMD/CLK are reserved for onboard flash; shown for physical identification, not spare GPIO. WROOM version, not WROVER. Use one supply method. Controller 3V3/5V header rails are typed as power outputs for normal USB/barrel-powered use; VIN is a power input. Alternative power injection through header rails must follow the manufacturer instructions.

entries.name: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 v1.1 — N8, 44 pins
entries.notes: 3.3 V logic. WROOM-1-N8 without PSRAM. GPIO46 input-only. GPIO35–37 availability differs on octal-memory variants; this is not those variants. v1.1 RGB LED uses GPIO38. USB data is also GPIO19/20. Use one supply method. Controller 3V3/5V header rails are typed as power outputs for normal USB/barrel-powered use; VIN is a power input. Alternative power injection through header rails must follow the manufacturer instructions.

entries.name: NodeMCU DevKit v1.0 — ESP-12E, 30 pins
entries.notes: 3.3 V logic. A0 is analogue input; board divider differs from bare ESP8266 TOUT. RSV pins have no user function. SD/CMD/CLK pins are connected to flash. Boot straps D3/D4/D8 require appropriate levels. Controller 3V3/5V header rails are typed as power outputs for normal USB/barrel-powered use; VIN is a power input. Alternative power injection through header rails must follow the manufacturer instructions.

entries.name: LOLIN D1 mini v3.1.0 — ESP8266, 16 pins
entries.notes: 3.3 V logic. v3.1.0 micro-USB board, not v4 USB-C/I2C-port variant. A0 divider permits up to 3.2 V. D3/D4/D8 are boot straps. Controller 3V3/5V header rails are typed as power outputs for normal USB/barrel-powered use; VIN is a power input. Alternative power injection through header rails must follow the manufacturer instructions.

entries.name: Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ — 40-pin GPIO
entries.notes: GPIO header only; physical pin numbers 1–40, BCM GPIO names, 3.3 V logic. 5 V GPIO is not tolerated. ID_SD/ID_SC are reserved for HAT EEPROM. Other sockets and auxiliary headers are illustrative housings, outside this wiring interface. Controller 3V3/5V header rails are typed as power outputs for normal USB/barrel-powered use; VIN is a power input. Alternative power injection through header rails must follow the manufacturer instructions.

entries.name: Arduino Uno R3
entries.notes: 5 V logic. All main wiring headers and fitted ICSP headers shown, with distinct physical terminal IDs. USB, barrel jack, test pads and unpopulated debug pads are outside the wiring interface. Supply pins can feed the board when used as documented; electrical power pins do not enforce supply selection. SDA duplicates A4; SCL duplicates A5. ICSP MISO/MOSI/SCK duplicate D12/D11/D13. Controller 3V3/5V header rails are typed as power outputs for normal USB/barrel-powered use; VIN is a power input. Alternative power injection through header rails must follow the manufacturer instructions.

entries.name: Adafruit SHT31-D temperature + humidity (original)
entries.notes: Original seven-pin board, not a generic six-pin module. I2C; VIN 3–5 V; RST active low, ALERT output.

entries.name: Adafruit BME280 temperature / humidity / pressure (original)
entries.notes: Original seven-pin breakout. VIN 3–5 V; 3Vo regulator output. I2C or SPI; SDO selects I2C address or provides SPI data.

entries.name: Adafruit BMP280 pressure + temperature (original)
entries.notes: Original seven-pin breakout; no humidity measurement. VIN 3–5 V; I2C or SPI.

entries.name: Adafruit BH1750 ambient light — STEMMA QT
entries.notes: I2C; VIN 3–5 V, 3Vo output, ADDR input.

entries.name: Adafruit VEML7700 ambient light (original)
entries.notes: Original five-pin breakout; I2C, VIN 3–5 V, 3Vo output.

entries.name: Adafruit TSL2591 high dynamic range light (original)
entries.notes: Original header order VIN,GND,3Vo,INT,SDA,SCL; differs from the QT revision. I2C; VIN 3–5 V.

entries.name: Adafruit VL53L0X time-of-flight distance (original)
entries.notes: Original seven-pin board; VIN 3–5 V; 2v8 is regulator output. I2C; XSHUT active low, GPIO interrupt output.

entries.name: Adafruit LIS3DH accelerometer (original)
entries.notes: Original eight-pin main header plus three ADC inputs. VIN 3–5 V; I2C/SPI.

entries.name: Adafruit MPU6050 accelerometer + gyro — STEMMA QT
entries.notes: Both six-pin rows and QT ports shown. VIN 3–5 V. AD0 selects address; FSYNC/CLKIN inputs; AUX SCL/SDA for external magnetometer.

entries.name: Adafruit SCD41 CO2 / temperature / humidity — STEMMA QT
entries.notes: SCD41 board revision, not SCD43. Genuine CO2 measurement, I2C; VIN 3–5 V; 3Vo output.

entries.name: Adafruit AT42QT1010 momentary capacitive touch
entries.notes: Momentary output, four-pin header LEDA,VDD,OUT,GND. 1.8–5.5 V. LEDA is the LED anode connection; do not treat it as a supply output.

entries.name: Adafruit AT42QT1012 latching capacitive touch
entries.notes: Latching version, five-pin header LEDA,VDD,TIME,OUT,GND. 1.8–5.5 V. TIME configures timeout.

entries.name: Adafruit STEMMA I2C capacitive soil moisture
entries.notes: Four-pin STEMMA PH connector GND,VIN,SDA,SCL. VIN 3–5 V; soil moisture and temperature. Connector is not pin-compatible with Grove.

entries.name: Grove Light sensor v1.1
entries.notes: Analogue output; 3.3/5 V supply. Calibrate thresholds for the application. Grove socket numbering: 1 signal/yellow, 2 unused/white, 3 VCC/red, 4 GND/black; socket is on the left in this view.

entries.name: Grove Sound sensor v1.6
entries.notes: Analogue microphone envelope output; not a digital sound-level meter. Grove socket numbering: 1 signal/yellow, 2 unused/white, 3 VCC/red, 4 GND/black; socket is on the left in this view.

entries.name: Grove PIR motion sensor v1.2
entries.notes: Digital motion output. Delay/sensitivity hardware controls shown. Main Grove connector only. Grove socket numbering: 1 signal/yellow, 2 unused/white, 3 VCC/red, 4 GND/black; socket is on the left in this view.

entries.name: Grove Buzzer v1.0
entries.notes: Drive SIG with a tone/PWM signal for pitch; digital HIGH also sounds the buzzer. Grove socket numbering: 1 signal/yellow, 2 unused/white, 3 VCC/red, 4 GND/black; socket is on the left in this view.

entries.name: Grove Button v1.0
entries.notes: Momentary button; digital signal output. Grove socket numbering: 1 signal/yellow, 2 unused/white, 3 VCC/red, 4 GND/black; socket is on the left in this view.

entries.name: Grove Water sensor v1.0
entries.notes: Digital detection via exposed conductive tracks; pin 2 unused. Grove socket numbering: 1 signal/yellow, 2 unused/white, 3 VCC/red, 4 GND/black; socket is on the left in this view.

entries.name: Grove Magnetic switch v1.3
entries.notes: Magnetic reed switch with digital output; pin 2 unused. Grove socket numbering: 1 signal/yellow, 2 unused/white, 3 VCC/red, 4 GND/black; socket is on the left in this view.

entries.name: DFRobot Gravity DHT22 — SEN0137 v2.0
entries.notes: 3.3–5 V; bidirectional single-data-wire bus, not I2C.

entries.name: DFRobot Gravity DS18B20 — DFR0024 v2.0
entries.notes: 3.3–5 V; 1-Wire temperature module with onboard pull-up.

entries.name: DFRobot capacitive soil moisture — SEN0193
entries.notes: 3.3–5.5 V supply; analogue output up to 3 V. Calibrate dry/wet readings.

entries.name: DFRobot Gravity relay — DFR0017 v3.0
entries.notes: V3.0, rotated with control socket left: SIG,VCC,GND top-to-bottom. Four screw terminals at right: COM,EMPTY,NO,NC top-to-bottom. EMPTY is physically present but unconnected; NC means normally closed and is a passive contact, not an unconnected pin. 5 V control supply. No relay simulation model.

entries.name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance module
entries.notes: 5 V module; ECHO is a 5 V output and needs level shifting/division for 3.3 V GPIO. Order VCC,TRIG,ECHO,GND with transducers facing the viewer and header below.

entries.name: DFRobot Gravity LCD1602 — DFR0555
entries.view: Front face at left; rear wiring view at right. Connector spacing enlarged to the normal grid. Screen glass/ribbons and optional auxiliary interfaces are outside the wiring interface.
entries.notes: 16x2 character LCD with integrated I2C interface; 3.3–5 V supply. Connector top-to-bottom VCC,GND,SCL,SDA in the illustrated rear view. The front and rear are two views of one module, not two devices. Wires attach only to the labelled rear contacts.

entries.name: DFRobot Gravity OLED 128x64 — DFR0486
entries.view: Front face at left; rear wiring view at right. Connector spacing enlarged to the normal grid. Screen glass/ribbons and optional auxiliary interfaces are outside the wiring interface.
entries.notes: SSD1306 OLED, 0.96 inch, 3.3–5 V supply. Rear top header left-to-right SDA,SCL,GND,VCC; the Gravity pin numbers run 4,3,2,1 in that view. The front and rear are two views of one module, not two devices. Wires attach only to the labelled rear contacts.

entries.name: Waveshare 1.8-inch SPI LCD — ST7735S
entries.view: Front face at left; rear wiring view at right. Connector spacing enlarged to the normal grid. Screen glass/ribbons and optional auxiliary interfaces are outside the wiring interface.
entries.notes: 128x160 colour TFT. P1 cable connector and P2 solder-header contacts both exposed. Pin order VCC,GND,DIN,CLK,CS,DC,RST,BL. Use 3.3 V supply/logic for Pi/ESP; follow your board revision documentation for 5 V Arduino interfacing. The front and rear are two views of one module, not two devices. Wires attach only to the labelled rear contacts.

entries.name: Waveshare 2.8-inch capacitive touch LCD
entries.view: Front face at left; rear wiring view at right. Connector spacing enlarged to the normal grid. Screen glass/ribbons and optional auxiliary interfaces are outside the wiring interface.
entries.notes: ST7789T3 TFT and CST328 capacitive touch. Thirteen-contact GH1.25 cable interface only; alternative 18-pin host FPC and internal panel/touch ribbons are outside this view. MISO is unavailable: leave this contact unconnected. Supply and host logic must match (3.3 V for Pi/ESP, 5 V for classic Arduino). The front and rear are two views of one module, not two devices. Wires attach only to the labelled rear contacts.

entries.name: Nextion Basic 2.8-inch resistive touch — NX3224T028_011
entries.view: Front face at left; rear wiring view at right. Connector spacing enlarged to the normal grid. Screen glass/ribbons and optional auxiliary interfaces are outside the wiring interface.
entries.notes: Basic series resistive touchscreen with local HMI processor, not an SPI framebuffer. 5 V supply (manufacturer recommends 500 mA supply capacity); TTL UART output typically 3.2 V, RX accepts 2.0–5.0 V HIGH. Cross screen TX to host RX and screen RX to host TX. Rear top connector left-to-right GND,RX,TX,5V. The front and rear are two views of one module, not two devices. Wires attach only to the labelled rear contacts.

entries.name: Waveshare 2.13-inch e-Paper HAT — V4, 8-pin cable
entries.view: Front face at left; rear wiring view at right. Connector spacing enlarged to the normal grid. Screen glass/ribbons and optional auxiliary interfaces are outside the wiring interface.
entries.notes: Black/white SPI e-paper with driver PCB, not a bare FPC panel. Main eight-pin wiring interface VCC,GND,DIN,CLK,CS,DC,RST,BUSY; BUSY is an output. 3.3 V hookup for Pi/ESP; match supply and logic per module documentation. Images persist without continuous refresh; full refresh is slow compared with LCD/OLED. Cable interface P3 only; optional Raspberry Pi 40-pin socket and internal panel FPC are outside this view. The front and rear are two views of one module, not two devices. Wires attach only to the labelled rear contacts.
